name: Miss Yay Facial & Head Spa

reviewSamples.author: Vero Massage
reviewSamples.text: Best treatment I've had, my skin feels renewed. (Crown Revival Ritual, with Yay Ortega)

reviewSamples.author: Liana
reviewSamples.text: Servicio y staff excelentes, es un lugar donde realmente puedes relajarte. Lo recomiendo al 100%. (Crown Revival Ritual)

reviewSamples.author: Ileana
reviewSamples.text: El espacio estaba limpio y acogedor, me senti muy comoda y me quede dormida durante la cita. (Luxury Scalp Renewal)

reviewSamples.author: Sonia
reviewSamples.text: Una de las experiencias mas relajantes que he tenido, todo con mucha atencion al detalle. Lo recomiendo al 100%! (Cleanse Scalp Treatment)

reviewSamples.author: Emily
reviewSamples.text: 10/10, truly one of the best experiences I've ever had! Felt refreshed and rejuvenated as a new mom. (Cleanse Scalp Treatment)

notes: Real booking profile + full priced menu (17 services) found on Booksy: https://booksy.com/en-us/1568975_miss-yay_skin-care_15761_tampa.
